response.sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), avg_all AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM order_counts), above AS (SELECT oc.account_id, oc.cnt FROM order_counts oc, avg_all a WHERE oc.cnt > a.avg_cnt), above_avg AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_above FROM above) SELECT ab.account_id, ab.cnt AS order_count, ab.cnt - a.avg_cnt AS diff_from_avg, ab.cnt - b.avg_above AS diff_from_above_avg FROM above ab, avg_all a, above_avg b ORDER BY diff_from_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10;
